location_exception_reason: Prefabricated huts are factory-manufactured portable structures sold nationwide; location is a project attribute, not a product differentiator. Buyers filter by structural specs (frame type, panel material, dimensions, wind/seismic compliance), not by manufacturing origin or seller location.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer) are redundant in titles; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'MS Frame PUF Panel Hut Manufacturer' leaves the product complete and unchanged.
